The compatibility characterization, full uniform-interior tangent space, and corrected product-marginal canonical gradient are proved. The exact published oracle shift is \(2\Gamma_a/B_a\), and a separate fitted equation (6) implication states its two convergence premises. The bounded interior is a strict subset of the final nonnegative-health published class, so this failure transfers upward. The corrected cross-fitted pair estimator attains its efficiency bound with a consistent row variance on the bounded, fixed-overlap, uniformly slack subclass under its explicit nuisance consistency and product-rate conditions.
